# Abstract

This repository contains the SQL model of the _Ros_ database from version **3.1.2** to nowadays.

## Update comments on database

```{r, warning = FALSE}
# Set up our database connection (if necessary)
# address of the host
# Sys.setenv(IOTC_ROS_DB_HOST="xxx")
# db name
# Sys.setenv(IOTC_ROS_DB_NAME=IOTC_ROS)
# db port
# Sys.setenv(IOTC_ROS_DB_PORT=5432)
# db user name
# Sys.setenv(IOTC_ROS_DB_USER="xxx")
# db user password
# Sys.setenv(IOTC_ROS_DB_PWD="xxx")
# Load sources
source("R/ros_db_metadata.R")
# Update for LL domain
ros_ll_queries <- apply_comments_on_db("LL")
# Update for PS domain
ros_ps_queries <- apply_comments_on_db("PS")
```
